brewing.notes: A safe starting point for green tea: cooler water, short steeps, then adjust by taste.

description:
A single-bud green tea from the foot of Laojun Mountain in Pingshan County, Yibin, Sichuan.

Treat it as you would any green tea: cooler water, short steeps, and a seller who can say where and when it was picked.
name_ru: И Бинь Сюй Фу Лун Я
history: It is a modern tea, developed jointly by the Sichuan Xufu Tea company and Southwest Agricultural University. The gardens lie at 800 to 1350 metres, and picking can begin in mid to late February.
processing: Made from single buds picked in high-altitude gardens.
harvest_season: Spring picking runs from mid-February into early or mid May.
taste_profile: Fresh and mellow with a sweet return and a lasting, refined aroma.
vintage_note: Green teas like this are normally sold as the current year's harvest and are best within a year of picking. It is not an ageing tea.
